description: Execute any supported GitHub action from the 83-action catalog by action name with parameters. Requires the exact action name (discovered via github_find_actions) and its corresponding argument dictionary. Output is automatically compressed with strict token projection filters (stripping hypermedia URL templates, avatar links, empty fields, node_ids) and formatted as compact Markdown by default. Mutating actions are blocked when running in read-only mode (GITHUB_READ_ONLY=true).

action.description: Exact name of the GitHub action to execute (e.g. 'create_pull_request', 'list_issues', 'trigger_workflow', 'create_branch')

format.description: Output format: 'markdown' (default, token-optimized compact table/text for LLM) or 'json' (structured JSON)

params.description: Parameters dictionary for the action matching its parameter schema

name: github_execute_action
title: Execute GitHub Action
